svg.title: ATLAS device: ESP32 board view
svg.desc: The ESP32 DevKit V1 from the ATLAS Wokwi simulation drawn as a circuit board: three LEDs through 220 ohm resistors on GPIO 25, 26 and 27, SELECT and SEND buttons on GPIO 14 and 12. SEND is pressed and the LEDs cycle through the four scenes of the architecture animation: ALLOW green, STEP_UP amber, DENY red, replay rejected red. Illustrative layout; simulated in Wokwi, not built on hardware.
